Name: THEN
Description: Operator that returns the first of two specified values when the conditional expression in IF-THEN-ELSE statement is True.

Arguments.name: expression
Arguments.description: Any expression that evaluates to true or false

Arguments.name: x
Arguments.description: , y An expression that evaluates to an output value

Returns: x when the conditional expression is true and y when the expression is false x y

Example.description: [If the value of 'att1' is greater than 50, then return the value of 'att2'; otherwise return the value of 'att3']
